chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

“The first false testimony given in Islam was the testimony of seventy men when they came to the water of al-Haw'ab and its dogs barked at them. Their female companion wanted to return and said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, saying to his wives: Indeed, one of you will be barked at by the dogs of al-Haw'ab while heading to fight my legatee, Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him. Then seventy men testified before her that this was not the water of al-Haw'ab, so this became the first testimony falsely given in Islam.”

ai.seo_question: What was the first false testimony given in Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that the first false testimony in Islam occurred at the water of al-Haw'ab, when seventy men denied the identity of the place. The report connects this event to a prior statement of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning one of his wives and her heading toward conflict with Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام. The narration highlights the gravity of false witness and its historical consequences.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3365 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"The first false testimony given in Islam was the testimony of seventy men when they reached the water of Haw'ab, and its dogs barked at them.
The woman among them intended to return and said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) say to his wives: One of you will be barked at by the dogs of Haw'ab while heading to fight my successor, Ali ibn Abi Talib (as).'
Then seventy men testified before her that it was not the water of Haw'ab. This was the first false testimony given in Islam."
